title: Andrew Gallimore DMT experiments and entities with consistent taxonomies
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Andrew Gallimore DMT experiments and entities with consistent taxonomies, about present (2026) at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and I know you're working with Andrew Gallammore who does, you know, these DMT experiments,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaking with the scientist Donald Hoffman, mentions that Hoffman is working with a neuroscientist named Andrew Gallimore, who runs experiments with DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug. The story behind it is that people on DMT report meeting beings that fall into consistent types, which, if true, would hint that those beings are more than random imagination.
